title: hi my bro!
description: A simple mod that greets you with friendly messages like "Hello my bro!". Makes your game more cozy.
body:
A very simple and lightweight mod that adds friendly messages to your Minecraft chat.

What this mod does:

Join Message: Greets you with "Hello my bro!" when you enter the world.

Sleeping: Says "Good morning!" when you wake up.

Night time: Wishes you "Good night!" when it gets dark.

Chat: Adds some cozy atmosphere when you use the chat.

It doesn't change gameplay, it just makes your survival feel a bit more friendly and less lonely. Perfect for single-player or playing with friends!
